resource:388992c7-0280-48d8-b147-13e636b: skip: field-rename dictionary between the old and new report formats (39 rows of metadata), not data; by_schema excludes it
reports.FUND_ID: key: track identity for dedup across period files, kpi:tracks
reports.FUND_NAME: chart-types, chart-type-yield, chart-tracks, chart-risk, insight:types, insight:sharpe — track type is read from the name
reports.PARENT_COMPANY_ID: skip: numeric code of the insurer — one-to-one with PARENT_COMPANY_NAME, which is charted
reports.FUND_CLASSIFICATION: chart-assets, chart-vintage, insight:vintage — policy vintage (1990–91, 1992–2003, 2004 onward)
reports.REPORT_PERIOD: chart-assets, chart-yields, chart-rolling, chart-annual, chart-fees, chart-exposure, kpi:assets
reports.TOTAL_ASSETS: chart-assets, chart-insurers, chart-types, chart-risk, insight:growth, kpi:assets
reports.AVG_DEPOSIT_FEE: chart-fees — reported by part of the tracks; disclosed in the chart note
reports.MONTHLY_YIELD: chart-yields, chart-rolling, chart-annual, insight:return, insight:annual, kpi:month_yield
reports.YIELD_TRAILING_3_YRS: skip: cumulative 3-year yield — the page uses its annualised twin (AVG_ANNUAL_YIELD_TRAILING_3YRS)
reports.YIELD_TRAILING_5_YRS: skip: cumulative 5-year yield — the page uses its annualised twin (AVG_ANNUAL_YIELD_TRAILING_5YRS)
reports.ALPHA: skip: alpha is measured against each track's own unpublished benchmark — not comparable across tracks
reports.PARENT_COMPANY_LEGAL_ID: skip: company registration number of the insurer — an identifier; the page uses the name
reports.REPORTING_YEAR: skip: duplicates the year part of REPORT_PERIOD (older files only)
reports.CURRENT_DATE: skip: file export timestamp (newest file only), not a data value
reports._resource_name: key: deterministic tie-break when a track-month appears in two period files
